title: Sepsis-3 Criteria
content: Sepsis is life-threatening organ dysfunction caused by dysregulated host response to infection. qSOFA criteria include altered mental status, systolic BP <=100, respiratory rate >=22.

title: SSC Hour-1 Bundle
content: Within 1 hour: measure lactate, obtain blood cultures, administer broad-spectrum antibiotics, begin fluid resuscitation for hypotension.

title: PREMONITION Model
content: PREMONITION uses logistic regression, random forest, and XGBoost ensemble for ICU sepsis early warning with SHAP explainability.

title: Test Protocol
content: All sepsis patients require lactate measurement within 1 hour.

title: Custom SOP
content: ICU rounding every 4 hours for sepsis patients.
